opening_thought: Green air. Petals underfoot. Growth — the pattern spreads; every object connects. Or: her backyard, a fence with height marks I didn't witness.

thoughts.lesson_2_garden: GROWTH. Things buried push toward light whether I watch or not. She grew up while I mapped the universe on my wall.
thoughts.garden_arbor_musings: Vines remember every trellis. I remember none of the summers — only that the word GROWTH belonged on soil, not paper.
thoughts.garden_clue_musings: Carved in the bed frame: GROWTH. Delusion: second proof of connection. Memory: pencil marks on a fence, dates in her mother's hand.

garden_clue_found.title: Garden Marker
garden_clue_found.body: Wooden marker in turned soil: GROWTH. Your ledger's second chapter. Or a yard you stopped visiting when the crow became easier than the door.

lesson_2_garden.title: Lesson — Growth
lesson_2_garden.body: Garden chest opened to GROWTH. Painting in the bedroom will yield now. You hid from her height marks by naming them cosmology.

garden_arbor.title: Arbor
garden_arbor.body: Ivy tangled on wooden arches — pause before the path splits. You built this pause into the myth so you wouldn't rush the lesson.

garden_clue.title: Flower Bed
garden_clue.body: Fresh soil. Marker reads GROWTH. Smell of cut grass underneath — memory trying to surface without permission.

garden_chest.title: Garden Chest
garden_chest.body: Small chest at the path's end. Letter lock. Wants GROWTH — a word, not a number. Same grammar as the bedroom.

ending.title: Growth
ending.body: Petals stick to your shoes. GROWTH returns with you — lesson earned, childhood measured in inches you weren't there to see.
